keyEvents.text: Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Guadalajara 1, Cruz Azul 0. Efraín Álvarez (Guadalajara) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Richard Ledezma with a cross.
Carlos Rodríguez (Cruz Azul) is shown the yellow card.
Carlos Rotondi (Cruz Azul) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Guadalajara 1, Cruz Azul 0.
Second Half begins Guadalajara 1, Cruz Azul 0.
